artifact_schema.description: The BLS12-381 G1 discrete logarithm, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

k.description: k with k*G = Q, in [1, r), zero-padded to exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

statement: Find k in the 255-bit prime-order BLS12-381 G1 subgroup such that k*G = Q, where G is the published G1 base point and Q is deterministically derived by the pinned checker. The target recipe hashes the public seed cairn/bls12-381/g1-dlog/v1 and a 32-bit counter with SHAKE256, takes the first x-coordinate whose curve equation has a square root, selects y parity from the digest, and multiplies that point by the full G1 cofactor. No scalar is selected in this construction. The checker independently confirms the resulting target is in the order-r subgroup. Submit k in [1,r) as exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits. The curve and subgroup parameters are pinned from the IETF pairing-friendly-curves specification; the point generator is checked against the published coordinates. The derived target is Q=(12ff3af11327a4ae78c6784662bc1276e53ec17e78e658365bd8cf386496d447e64127b864dc2b16d2205440a3f5c993, 049c096a3f1e99d15f74171c0c63941a080a813753138f6d64b8b58016bc577a6f54c6379475d06a1620953385711be9); the first valid counter is 0.
